title: 7 free Google AI tools you should be using
description:
Google quietly shipped 7 free AI tools. Here's what each one does.

1. Stitch — design full app UIs from a prompt
2. AI Studio Build — build web apps in plain English
3. Opal — build no-code AI mini-apps
4. NotebookLM — turn your docs into podcasts and videos
5. Pomelli — generate on-brand marketing in seconds
6. Gemini Canvas — turn documents into slide decks
7. Nano Banana Pro — studio-grade AI images

All free.

#AItools #Google #Gemini #AI #Shorts
